name: prompt-coach
description: /coach opens a pane that checks, rewrites and explains your draft prompt for the model your session runs, with model tips and your recurring gaps; /improve rewrites a draft straight into the prompt box; a Week tab with Claude Week, a weekly digest you vote on.

rewriteModel.title: Rewrite model
rewriteModel.description: The model for Analyze, live mode and /improve. haiku is fastest and cheapest; sonnet writes better rewrites.

refreshModel.title: Refresh model
refreshModel.description: The model that rewrites rules and tips on /coach refresh, only for files whose source pages changed. opus changes the least it needs to.

weekModel.title: Week model
weekModel.description: The model that writes each Claude Week edition in the coach pane's Week tab, from the source pages the mod fetches. opus sticks to its sources more closely.
